### Folio CLI Documentation

#### folio index ./notes

**Usage:** `folio index ./notes`

**Description:** This command builds a local index of the notes located at the specified path. It does not upload any notes to a remote server.

**Example:**

```bash
folio index ./notes
```

This command will create a local index of all the notes within the directory `./notes`. The index is saved locally and can be used to search and manage the notes locally. The notes are not uploaded to any remote server, ensuring that the local index is the only copy of the notes available.

**Note:** Folio requires Python 3.11 to run. Make sure you have the correct version of Python installed before running the command.
